desc:
🏘️ TOWN UPDATE: New suburb map with traffic lights, cars, a gas station, shops and houses full of people! Plus 11 new weapons and realistic guns.

Smash, launch and knock over wobbly ragdoll dummies – every hit uses real active ragdoll physics!

🩸 Blocky cartoon blood – shoot their legs and they crawl away! (Can be turned off in Settings.)
🧍 SMART DUMMIES: They drag knocked-out friends to safety, revive them, stare – and sometimes take revenge.
🥊 SANDBOX: Punch, kick and shove dummies off rooftops.
⚔️ WAVES: Brawlers attack in waves – knock them out or push them off!
🔫 48 WEAPONS + 4 SUPERPOWERS: From frying pans to the AK-47 and orbital laser – unlock them with K.O.s.
🗺️ 12 MAPS: City, Suburbs, Downtown, Highway, Office Tower, Construction Site, Backyard, Warehouse, Rooftops, Rooftop Arena, Sky Stairs, Subway.
💥 EVENTS: Nuke, Dummy Rain, Zero Gravity, Firestorm, Deep Freeze, Black Hole.
⭐ Earn money for every fall and combo – 10 ranks to climb.

Play in English or German!
